items.title: Louis Cottrell, Jr. Interview, 1961-08-25
items.q: The interviewee only responds to the interviewer's mention of Natty Brave by saying 'I wouldn't be surprised because they were very good friends,' referring to Natty Brave and the interviewee's father, not a direct relationship with Natty Brave himself.

ctx.x: If they weren't going on streetcars they would be walking. You take so many of the guys that walk from one engagement to another from their home. I heard Boca stayed on the session down at the Jean-Sami Hall, that drummer that he played with during that period was a fellow by the name of Veen. And Veen walked all the way up to the protection and I went back with his drum.

One funny story, I remember Natty Dominic, you know Don Albers of course. Yes, I know Natty too. His uncle, Natty Brave on Chicago. We got about six or seven tapes, the story of his life. Talked to him a long time and he started out on drums, I'm pretty sure. Maybe he had a few lessons with your father. Yeah, I know he talked about your father.
I wouldn't be surprised because they were very good friends.
